findings.title: 1 backfill(s) failed for "SAMPLE Call Center Events"
findings.detail: A failed backfill leaves a gap in historical data, and a backfill feed can only export data that CJA holds.
findings.fix: List the backfills for this dataset and check the status and date range of the failed ones.
findings.kbQuery: conn.backfill-failed 1 backfill(s) failed for "SAMPLE Call Center Events"

findings.title: New data is not being imported for "SAMPLE Call Center Events"
findings.detail: The dataset reports streaming as off. In the connection settings this normally corresponds to importing all new data, so batches ingested later will not reach CJA or any data feed.
findings.fix: Confirm the "import all new data" setting for this dataset in the Connections interface.
findings.kbQuery: conn.import-new-data-off New data is not being imported for "SAMPLE Call Center Events"

findings.title: Event datasets use different identity namespaces
findings.detail: Datasets merge on the person ID value. Values from different namespaces rarely match, so journeys across these datasets can stay separate. This may be intentional.
findings.fix: If you expect one person across these sources, align the person ID or consider stitching.
findings.kbQuery: conn.identity-namespace-mismatch Event datasets use different identity namespaces

findings.title: Lookup dataset "SAMPLE Product Lookup" has no key field
findings.detail: Without a key field the lookup cannot be joined to event data, so its values stay empty in reports and feeds.
findings.kbQuery: conn.lookup-incomplete Lookup dataset "SAMPLE Product Lookup" has no key field

findings.title: "SAMPLE Call Center Events" has not ingested data for 10 days
findings.detail: The last ingestion was more than 3 days ago. A live data feed will be empty or sparse while ingestion is stale.
findings.fix: Check recent batches for this dataset in Experience Platform, and the import setting in the connection.
findings.kbQuery: conn.stale-ingestion "SAMPLE Call Center Events" has not ingested data for 10 days

findings.title: 1 component name(s) are used more than once
findings.detail: When feed columns are picked by name it is ambiguous which component is meant.
findings.fix: Rename the duplicates in the data view so each name is distinct.
findings.kbQuery: dv.duplicate-names 1 component name(s) are used more than once

findings.title: 2 component(s) report no data
findings.detail: A feed column built on a component with no data would be empty.
findings.fix: Check whether the field is populated in the schema and in the connected datasets, or leave it out of the feed.

findings.title: Backfill is disabled for this connection
findings.detail: Historical data from before the connection was created is not imported, which limits what a backfill feed can export.

findings.title: The connection has no description
findings.detail: A description helps the next person understand which sources this connection combines.
findings.kbQuery: conn.no-description The connection has no description

findings.title: 11 of 14 dimensions have no description
findings.detail: Descriptions help people choose the right columns.
findings.kbQuery: dv.missing-descriptions 11 of 14 dimensions have no description

findings.title: The data view has no description
findings.detail: A description tells the next person what this data view is for.
findings.kbQuery: dv.no-description The data view has no description

findings.title: 1 component(s) are named like raw schema paths
findings.detail: Feed columns take their names from data view components, so readable names make the files easier to use.
findings.kbQuery: dv.raw-schema-names 1 component(s) are named like raw schema paths
